name: execute the compiled fortran program to regenerate a fixed output file
definition: run the built program so it produces the expected textual output file without the agent deleting or overwriting it.
failure_mode: program not run or output malformed fails the content check

name: implement the metacircular evaluator of a scheme-like interpreter
definition: Write code in the target language whose semantics mirror a reference interpreter: env analysis, procedures with closure capture when closures form, and the evaluator patterns (eval/apply) required by that dialect.

name: reverse-engineer the exact arithmetic/range-coding scheme of the decoder
definition: Analyze the C decompressor to determine precisely how it reads bits and integers from the stream, including its radix, renormalization ranges, and context split computations, so an encoder can reproduce its expectations.
failure_mode: Any mismatch in the bit/integer coding model corrupts or truncates the decoded output.

name: rework a makefile for a different fortran compiler frontend
definition: adjust the build rules/flags from the legacy compiler to use gfortran while keeping the two source files (a library module and a main program) intact.
failure_mode: compiler-specific flags or missing source rule make make fail
